fields.notes: FlexRay's protocol-level DFT surface is the Controller Host Interface status (POC state, counters, clock-sync, CRC flags) plus the symbol-window MTS and monitor/loopback modes. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain CC-vendor / SoC-integrator concerns. Conformance is established by the FlexRay conformance test.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Controller Host Interface (CHI)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Primary in-band controllability/observability: configure the CC and read POC state, counters, clock-sync status, and CRC error flags.

in_band_test_facilities.name: POC status (vPOC!State)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Observe the protocol state machine for bring-up and fault diagnosis.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Clock-sync status
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Offset/rate correction values and sync-frame counts for synchronization health.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Media access Test Symbol (MTS)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Probe media access in the symbol window.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Cycle counter (0..63), macrotick counter, slot counter.
Clock-sync offset/rate correction values and sync-frame counts.
Header / Frame CRC error flags per channel.
out_of_band_test_facilities: FlexRay conformance test suite (ISO 17458-3 data-link, ISO 17458-5 physical-layer conformance).
Vendor CC / transceiver bring-up and characterization tooling (implementation-defined).

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
